summary: Full end-to-end verification of the new 'Related Products pinning' feature. Backend picker search, quick-update persistence, and public related endpoint all pass (5/5 pytest). Admin QuickEditProductDrawer 'Related Products' panel opens, expands, searches, adds pins, shows duplicate toast, persists across save/reopen. Storefront /shop/collection/TestSeries shows Bluestone with STAFF PICK badge first in 'Customers Also Liked' and Self-adhesive Mesh with HAND-PICKED label first in 'You May Also Need'. Regression on Sale/About/More Specs/Variants panels still OK.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend picker endpoint correctly returns 200 with empty list for queries <2 chars.

quick-update route sanitizes and persists related_products to both supplier_products and tiles (when show_on_website=true) - roundtrip confirmed via GET /api/tiles/related/TestSeries returning pinned:true first and pinned_you_may_need array populated.
60s cache on /api/tiles/related/{series} may briefly delay storefront reflecting new pins; consider invalidating cache on quick-update save if instant preview is desired.
Admin QuickEditProductDrawer panel header count correctly reflects saved pins after save+reopen ('1 liked · 1 need').
Duplicate add correctly shows 'Already pinned in that section' toast rather than duplicating pin.

Storefront correctly renders 'STAFF PICK' badge and 'HAND-PICKED' pill; the Self-adhesive Mesh pin resolves via /api/tiles/collection/{series} and displays with 'Recommended for this product' subtext.
seed_data_creation: Used existing LP-6611 pins seeded by main agent (BLUE-GR-60 also_liked, TSM-100-0100 you_may_need). Test file resets these back to the same state after clear-and-reset test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working end-to-end. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_related_products_pinning.py covers picker search (bluestone + short query), quick-update set/clear/reset pins for LP-6611, and public related endpoint. Frontend selectors used: quick-edit-related-panel, related-toggle, related-search-input, related-search-results, related-add-liked-{sku}, related-add-need-{sku}, related-pin-also_liked-{sku}, related-pin-you_may_need-{sku}, staff-pick-badge, you-may-also-need-section.
